rv.q: The show is a bona fide buffet of beautiful music, offering just a sample of the many superb songs that Mr. Sondheim created.
Each of the ensemblists has a clear, powerful voice, creating the perfect canvas for which to display the complex and varied works of Sondheim.
4 Chairs, under the direction of Ms Berman is doing what I would have to call a wonderful evening at the theater at the Skokie Theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise this heartfelt celebration of Sondheim's rich musical legacy, with strong performances showcasing the composer's brilliant lyricism and emotional depth across his beloved and obscure works alike.
